CLI-as-first-class-agent-target (umbrella #117, design docs/design-117-cli-agent-parity.md). Driven by a real deployment blocker: at least one user's employer bans MCP servers outright, so the CLI is the ONLY agent surface for that cohort. Serves project.goals #4 (agent-agnostic).

KEY INSIGHT: functional parity already existed (all MCP tools have CLI commands); the gap was three MCP protocol AFFORDANCES: (1) structured I/O, (2) the handshake/fetchable instructions, (3) session statefulness.

STATUS: WS1 (universal JSON envelope; D3 LOCKED — bare --json read output broken in favor of the envelope) and WS2 (surface-aware instructions, AGENTS.md from init, rvr manifest) SHIPPED in v1.1.0/v1.1.1. REMAINING: WS3 session-state/observability parity = #119 (RVR_SESSION-bridged write-amp guard + telemetry; confirm-token flow deliberately NOT ported — stateless REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION envelope instead).
